name: Archify
summary: Agent skill that turns plain-English descriptions or a codebase into explorable, self-contained HTML diagrams.
description: An MIT-licensed agent skill that has AI coding agents turn descriptions, plans or repositories into interactive single-file HTML diagrams, validated before they ship. Output supports five typed diagram modes — architecture, workflow, sequence, data flow and lifecycle — with dark/light themes, path tracing and PNG or motion export; a scenario guide offers 12 starting recipes. Free and open source.
contains: installs as an agent skill: npx skills add tt-a1i/archify -g
works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode and Copilot
